bio: The restaurant is somewhat hidden away, in a beautiful location overlooking the lake, Wallersee – the view from the terrace to the rear of the building is magnificent, but you can also enjoy the view from some of the tables inside. Eclectic design details such as furniture, figurines and pictures, as well as strikingly colourful Murano glass chandeliers, create decorative accents in the tasteful interior. The cuisine is international, so the menu features dishes such as "oysters, artichokes, lemon marmalade" and dim sum with various fillings. Friendly and attentive service.
